facts.text: Jolene stated that interacting with people who love their work has inspired her to stay focused and work towards her goals.

evidence.quote: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals.

facts.text: Jolene mentioned that applying her school knowledge to real projects has been the best part of her internship.

evidence.quote: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects.

facts.text: Jolene admitted that finding a good work-life balance during her internship has been difficult, as she has been working hard and struggling to make time for hobbies and relaxation.

evidence.quote: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.
